logic: A causally confirmed 4h swing is a one-use external liquidity pool. Exceptional-turnover consumption starts a competition between next-hour outside-price acceptance continuation and inside-price rejection rotation toward the nearest still-unconsumed causal pool.
pivot_rule: two completed bars on each side; usable only after the second right-side 4h bar completes
event_rule: first later 1h close at least 0.10 prior-only ATR20 through the outermost newly consumed pool and above pooled calendar-2021 prior-only log-turnover-z q75
decision_rule: immediately next completed 1h close; outside=ACCEPT, inside=REJECT
entry_rule: first observed 1m open strictly later than decision available_at + 500ms; cancel when intervening completed minute consumed target, crossed stop, or invalidated level
target_rule: nearest still-unconsumed confirmed 4h pool in selected action direction, known before entry
stop_rule: one tick plus 0.10 decision ATR20 beyond full signal/decision excursion extreme
state_exit_rule: first later completed 1h close through broken level against action, executed after 500ms
